notes: The post is credited to 'Keith McDonald "Deck Masters" and Marc Dersch'; the page credits Keith McDonald (named first) and names Marc Dersch as co-builder.

Starting cards: the objective (posted 'Angents Of The Black Sun') plus three Effects marked '(S)': Oppressive Combo, Secret Plans and Imperial Arrest Order; no starting interrupt is posted. All count toward the 60 (posted total 60).

Posted 'Angents Of The Black Sun' dested Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince; 'Corascant', 'Corascant Docking Bay', 'Corascant Imperial City' the Dark Special Edition Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition), Coruscant: Docking Bay and Coruscant: Imperial City; 'Tatooine Cantina', 'Tatooine Docking Bay', 'Adiance Chamber' and 'Tatooine' the Dark pages.
Posted 'Ordiment..' x2 (under Interrupts) is kept as written: probably Abyssin Ornament, but the plain card and the Abyssin Ornament & Wounded Wookiee combo both fit.
Posted 'Monoc' (under Interrupts) dested Monnok, not the Mynock creature; 'Bealo' Boelo; 'Mercinary Pilo' Mercenary Pilot; 'Price Xizar' Prince Xizor.
Posted 'Bossk In Bus', 'Dengar In Ship', 'Fett in Ship' and 'Zuckus In SHip' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth, Dengar In Punishing One, Boba Fett In Slave I and Zuckuss In Mist Hunter.

Posted 'Defence Fire combo' dested Defensive Fire & Hutt Smooch; 'Suns Down Combo' Sunsdown & Too Cold For Speeders; 'Oppressive Combo' There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'Skum And Vilany' Scum And Villainy; 'There WIll Be Hell To Pay' There'll Be Hell To Pay.
Secret Plans (posted 'Secrate Plans') is the 2001 Special Edition Effect, not a Defensive Shield.
Posted 'Disrupter Pistal' dested Disruptor Pistol (Dark); 'Vibro Ax' Vibro-Ax (Dark); 'Skiff' Skiff (Dark).

Posted 'Shocking Info' dested Shocking Revelation: Shocking Information is the Light card; Shocking Revelation is its Dark counterpart (also destiny 5, matching the strategy's 'a 5 always at the bottom of your deck').
